privacy_boundary: Derived and redacted public projection. Private memories, local paths, raw transcripts, credentials, contacts, device state, and third-party context are excluded.

cases.problem_class: Memory consolidation dry-run accepted an explicit source path outside the intended boundary.
cases.repair: Constrain explicit sources to the local run directory and validate generated consolidation records before trust.
cases.human_role: The observer returned a bounded critique. The front-stage operator accepted it, patched the implementation, and reran validation.
validation: Dry-run passes for default bounded discovery.
Out-of-bound explicit source fails closed.
In-bound explicit source passes.
No unattended apply or durable memory write is approved.
anti_signals: A future consolidation path writes durable memory without a separate review.
A source-boundary failure becomes a warning rather than a hard block.
cases.private_boundary: Exact private receipt paths and internal memory IDs are not public.
cases.next_experiment: Add a private-to-public redaction gate before publishing future consolidation cases.

cases.problem_class: Stale task next expected events appeared as isolated backlog noise.
cases.repair: Project repair-needed events into grouped patterns and create bounded repair plans instead of mutating source tasks silently.
cases.human_role: This is a planning case, not an automatic mutation. A later repair receipt is required before source state changes.
validation: Scanner writes only its own intermediate events and receipts.
Repeated scans dedupe.
Digest groups repair-needed events by repair class.
Repair plans require a later receipt before source mutation.
anti_signals: Owner-facing notification volume rises with event volume.
Repair plans mutate source state without receipts.
cases.private_boundary: Raw task records and dashboard payloads remain private unless separately redacted.
cases.next_experiment: Add a safe public summary generator for repair-plan outcomes.

cases.problem_class: Fleet rule sync command payload exceeded a conservative remote command parameter limit.
cases.repair: Stage the large bridge artifact in small chunks and keep the main bootstrap command below the parameter limit.
cases.human_role: The front-stage operator executed the rollout, classified a network-environment blocker separately from the payload blocker, and retried the failed region.
validation: Dry run renders every parameter file below the configured limit.
Live rollout restarts the cloud fleet poller after clearing malformed proxy environment variables for the command process.
One failed region succeeds after a scoped retry.
Duplicate backlog records close against a shared repair receipt.
anti_signals: Future rule sync fails on parameter size again.
A network proxy failure is misdiagnosed as a payload failure.
A partial rollout is reported as complete without per-node status.
cases.private_boundary: Provider account identifiers, private run artifacts, and local machine paths are not public.
cases.next_experiment: Teach the rollout runner to sanitize network proxy variables or report proxy misconfiguration before sending commands.

cases.problem_class: Primary edge laptop OS sleep emitted skeleton records with nightly completion tags, blinding cloud standby failover checks.
cases.repair: Enforce atomic phase-status validation (emitting status:analyse-failed on interruption), substantive byte-length thresholds (>=2048b), and automatic supersedes:<id> cloud takeover.
cases.human_role: The operator investigated false-green reporting, confirmed the edge suspend gap, approved schema gates, and verified autonomous standby takeover.
validation: Primary interruption emits status:analyse-failed with explicit interrupted phase keys.
Standby rejects stubs under 2048 bytes or missing analytical schema sections.
Standby automatically triggers failover execution and writes supersedes:<skeleton_id> records.
Memory hub indices correctly surface the authoritative superseding record.
anti_signals: A standby liveness check relies purely on boolean tag presence.
An interrupted pipeline run publishes a completion tag.
cases.private_boundary: Exact hardware node names, power-management logs, and private memory IDs are excluded.
cases.next_experiment: Add proactive heartbeat decay detection to trigger standby preparation prior to scheduled cutoff.

cases.problem_class: Multi-agent desktop client runtime persisted session transcripts in Base32 blobs, siloing knowledge from CLI and server fleet agents.
cases.repair: Deploy a resident roster-aware Base32 replica decoder streaming canonical JSONL into a unified SQLite FTS5 index (fleet-sql) on a 60-second systemd timer.
cases.human_role: The operator detected the cross-agent knowledge gap, approved the replica architecture, and validated cross-agent recall across all 10 persona roles.
validation: Base32 decoder converts client storage chunks into structured JSONL without runtime lockups.
SQLite FTS5 index executes cross-agent full-text queries in <1s.
CLI and cloud server agents successfully cite conclusions reached in desktop agent deliberation rooms.
anti_signals: An agent persona stores transcripts in a private format unreadable by the replica decoder.
Cross-agent retrieval latency exceeds 5 seconds during active deliberation.
cases.private_boundary: Local filesystem paths, application binary signatures, and sensitive session tokens are redacted.
cases.next_experiment: Integrate real-time socket-based event streaming from the desktop client to eliminate the 60-second polling window.

cases.problem_class: Asynchronous STT acoustic reconciler dropped a negation token 37 seconds post-utterance, silently inverting user negative constraints.
cases.repair: Implement Immutable Negative-Constraint Locking in the dispatch envelope, a 5-second pacing debounce on high-impact workers, and mandatory confirmation on polarity inversion.
cases.human_role: The principal detected unintended sub-agent dispatch, traced the acoustic reconciler polarity reversal, and established the immutable negative-constraint rule.
validation: Explicit negative tokens (do not, stop, exclude, pause) lock into an immutable constraint bag.
Downstream STT acoustic updates cannot delete or overwrite locked negative constraints.
Polarity inversions immediately halt dispatch and request principal confirmation.
anti_signals: A streaming refinement pass silently converts an exclusion into an inclusion.
A sub-agent is dispatched to work on an explicitly excluded domain.
cases.private_boundary: Raw audio waveform buffers, phoneme probabilities, and principal voice samples remain strictly local.
cases.next_experiment: Train a small on-device classifier to predict speech turn completion certainty before speculative tool invocation.

cases.problem_class: Out-of-vocabulary entity distortion in speech recognition led to premature worker dispatch and false attribution to overlay-network isolation.
cases.repair: Incorporate phonetic and Levenshtein vocabulary grounding against the fleet registry before dispatch, and enforce tiered empirical diagnostics (L7 -> L4 -> L3).
cases.human_role: The operator intercepted the hallucinated network failure incident, confirmed the service was simply unstarted locally, and mandated evidence-backed diagnostic steps.
validation: Unknown entity tokens match against the fleet registry with Levenshtein distance filtering.
Ambiguous entities pause dispatch for clarification rather than launching workers.
Diagnostic agents must execute and quote pgrep and ss -tulpn output before alleging transport failure.
anti_signals: Dispatch occurs on an unregistered entity name without confirmation.
A diagnostic agent cites overlay VPN failure while the target daemon is unlistening on localhost.
cases.private_boundary: Internal VPN overlay mesh addresses, internal hostnames, and service port mappings are sanitized.
cases.next_experiment: Compile a dynamic phonetic cache updated automatically whenever new agent roles or tools are registered.

cases.problem_class: Agents offloaded implementation tactics onto the human principal, while phantom completions (exit code 0 on dead endpoints) bypassed verifiers.
cases.repair: Enforce Dao/Shu separation restricting human chat to <=3 lines of strategic status while fleet handles tactics, and mandate independent verification barriers (worker_exit != verified).
cases.human_role: The principal defined the Dao/Shu standing rule, set the concise 3-line reporting constraint, and mandated independent verification probes.
validation: Human chat receives high-level status and value/direction questions in <=3 lines without tactical menus.
Fleet agents autonomously resolve transient errors, library choices, and restart recovery.
Tasks require independent functional verifier execution before status flips to verified.
Phantom worker completions with exit code 0 but failing health probes are blocked and flagged.
anti_signals: An agent asks the human to choose between low-level technical tactics or run manual terminal commands.
A task is marked verified without an independent verification probe.
cases.private_boundary: Private personal correspondence, financial contexts, and internal model provider credentials are excluded.
cases.next_experiment: Automate verification probe generation alongside task decomposition in the coordinator agent.
